Author: Charlie1361
Name: XIVibration
Punchline: Controller vibration on every hit of every skill, as strong as its sound.
Description: Every skill of every job makes your gamepad vibrate on each of its hits. After you log in, the plugin reads every skill's animation and sounds (the ones actually loaded, through Penumbra if you use mods). You choose which animation cues make a hit (hit reactions, hit sounds, follow-up strikes, built-in vibration, MultiHit tables...) and how many must coincide; skills without hit markers use the peaks in their sound as hits; each pulse is as strong as the sound is loud at that hit, with bass driving the strong motor and crisp sounds the weak one, and the last hit is always the strongest. Optionally, patterns can be built from the sound's bumps instead. The vibration goes through the game's own controller function, so it works with every controller the game supports, and only your own character's skills vibrate. Skills are grouped by job, and every pattern can be edited on a DAW-style timeline that shows the sound; your edits are never overwritten.
